- Ensure compliance with data privacy regulations like GDPR, CCPA, etc.
- Implement encryption for sensitive data both in transit and at rest.

- Use explainable AI techniques to provide insights into model decisions.

- Implement a feedback mechanism to collect user feedback and improve the model.

- Continuously evaluate the performance of the bot using metrics like accuracy, precision, recall, and F1 score.
